name: movienight
description: Weekly movie/series sessions researched from what is actually available on your streaming platforms, personalized by your reactions.
post_install: Restart the platform: docker compose restart endpoint-platform (applies 020_movienight.sql, hot-loads the app).
Open the Movie Night tab: GET /api/movienight/settings to check defaults; configure platforms or country via PUT /api/movienight/settings.
Run a session: POST /api/movienight/generate (the digestos hub calls this weekly; manual runs are fine for testing).
Watch reactions: POST /api/movienight/taste to log what you've watched — reactions sharpen next week's session.
